sources.title: GitHub - allenai/molmo: Code for the Molmo Vision-Language Model
sources.snippet: Molmo is a repository for training and using Ai2's state-of-the-art multimodal open language models. Here is a video demo of Molmo's capabilities. Try Molmo using our public demo showcasing the Molmo-7B-D model. This codebase is based on the OLMo codebase with the addition of vision encoding and integrating generative evaluations.
